platforms.title: Platforms it works on
platforms.description: Rewards and alerts from these platforms take snaps, and replies go to their chats.

rewardTitles.title: Rewards that take a snap
rewardTitles.description: The exact reward titles. Twitch and Kick channel point rewards work, and so do points rewards in chat from Viewer Points on every platform. Ask viewers for text in the reward and it becomes the caption.

rewardCaption.title: Caption when the viewer leaves no message

snapCommand.title: Command for you and your moderators
snapCommand.description: Type !snap and a caption to take a snap from chat, or !snap pause and !snap resume. A Stream Deck button can send it through Streamer.bot from your own account. Do not include the ! prefix.

alerts.title: Alerts that take a snap
alerts.description: These take a snap by themselves, with the caption below.

minimumRaid.title: Smallest raid that takes a snap

minimumBits.title: Fewest Bits that take a snap

raidCaption.title: Raid caption
raidCaption.description: {name} is the raider and {amount} the number of viewers.

captureTarget.title: What the picture shows
captureTarget.description: One source (such as your camera) keeps the snap animation out of its own picture.

captureSource.title: OBS source or scene
captureSource.description: The exact name in OBS. Press Refresh to pick it from the list.

saveFolder.title: Folder for the pictures
saveFolder.description: A full folder path on this PC. Leave empty to use Pictures\StreamBridge Snaps.

showCaption.title: Write the caption on the photo

showName.title: Write the name and date on the photo

blockedWords.title: Words that hide the caption
blockedWords.description: If a message has one of these, the photo still prints but without the caption. Links are always removed.

cooldownSeconds.title: Seconds between snaps
cooldownSeconds.description: For the whole channel. You and your moderators skip it.

viewerCooldownSeconds.title: Seconds before the same viewer can snap again

queueLimit.title: Snaps that can wait in line

skipScenes.title: Put the camera away on these scenes
skipScenes.description: No snaps while one of these scenes is live, such as BRB or Starting Soon. role:brb and the other roles follow Scene roles.

refundSkipped.title: Give the reward back when no snap is taken
refundSkipped.description: Twitch channel points and Viewer Points. Kick rewards cannot be given back.

sound.title: Play the shutter and print sounds

chatReplies.title: Reply in chat when a snap cannot be taken

cooldownMessage.title: Cooldown reply
cooldownMessage.default: {name}, the camera needs {seconds} more seconds to cool down.

busyMessage.title: Queue full reply
busyMessage.default: {name}, the camera is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

pausedMessage.title: Camera put away reply
pausedMessage.default: {name}, the camera is put away right now.

discordWebhookId.title: Post each snap to Discord
discordWebhookId.description: Optional. Pick one of your Discord webhooks.
